{"result": "## The Pizza Plan

You and Devon agreed to get **pizza at Luigi's on 5th this Friday at 7:00 pm**. Devon will meet you there rather than picking you up.

### How it came together

- Devon asked if you were "still in a pizza mood" — you said you're always in the mood for pizza.
- Devon proposed **Luigi's on Friday**; you confirmed you meant the location on **5th**, and Devon said yes, that's the one.
- You said you were down and asked about timing. Devon suggested **7pm**, and you agreed that works.
- Devon closed with "cool I'll meet you there," so the plan is to **meet at the restaurant**, not travel together.

### At a glance

| Detail | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Who | You and Devon |
| What | Pizza |
| Where | Luigi's on 5th |
| Day | Friday |
| Time | 7:00 pm |
| Logistics | Devon meets you there |

### One thing to keep separate from this plan

In the same conversation window there was a *different* weekend plan being floated in a group chat with Maya and Devon: seeing the **ducks at the pond on Saturday morning around 9am**, timed to beat the heat. Maya suggested it, Devon agreed, but you said your Saturday was up in the air and explicitly told them **not to plan around you**. So that one is tentative and doesn't involve you committing — unlike the Friday pizza plan, which is confirmed on your side.

### Practical note

Everything above comes from messages collected the evening of Thursday, September 10, 2026, with the pizza outing set for the following day, Friday, September 11. If anything shifted afterward, it isn't recorded here — but as of that conversation, the arrangement is firm: **Luigi's on 5th, Friday, 7pm, meeting Devon there.**"}
